settings.restoreModeNote: Restores detail without enlarging the image.
settings.upscaleModeNote: Enlarges the image with an AI model.
settings.targetNativeNote: The model reconstructs at {{native}}× from the source (brought down to 1080p above that), then the result is fitted to the target.
settings.shaderGpuNote: Local GPU processing — no manual download required.
settings.parallelShaderNote: Only for lightweight shaders. AI remains sequential to avoid exhausting VRAM.
settings.scale1Note: Restores at the original size (cleans up without enlarging).
settings.debandNote: Smooths visible banding in gradients (sky, shadows). More = smoother.
settings.grainNote: A bit of noise added to break up leftover banding.
settings.sharpNote: Soft = smoother image · Sharp = harder edges (can look a bit harsh).
settings.antiRingingNote: Avoids bright halos/fringes around edges when enlarging.
settings.ditherNote: Cuts color banding in 8-bit output. Leave it on Yes.
settings.precisionNote: fp16 = 2× faster, same look (recommended). fp32 = slower, only if you see artifacts.
settings.noiseCleanupNote: Smooths residual noise after AI while preserving linework. Start with Light.
settings.edgeCleanupNote: Reduces fringes, halos and overly hard edges created by enlargement.
settings.removeBgHint: ProRes 4444 imports straight into Resolve with its alpha.
settings.rtxNote: RTX VSR upscales exactly 2× and rejects sources at 1440p or above. Output is 10-bit HEVC NVENC.
settings.vsrQualityNote: SDK reconstruction level: 1 is fastest, 4 is most detailed.
settings.trueHdrNote: Converts SDR to HDR10. Off by default: the result only reads correctly on an HDR display and an HDR timeline. An already-HDR source is left untouched.
settings.hdrParamsNote: SDK defaults (125 / 100 / 25 / 1000 nits). Peak luminance is written into the master's metadata.
settings.scaleResampledNote: This model reconstructs at {{native}}×; other factors just resize its output afterwards.
settings.windowedModelNote: This model runs a fixed-shape graph: only the window overlap is adjustable.
settings.outputHint: An encoded video, or one image per frame in its own folder.
settings.outputStillNote: A still source writes an image: the video codec does not apply.
settings.outputMixedNote: The selection mixes videos and stills: each source writes its own form.
settings.pngBitsNote: 16-bit only adds precision when the op produces it: depth maps, not upscaling.
settings.pngCompressionNote: Lossless at every level: only write time and file size change.
settings.jpegQualityNote: JPEG quantizes the image and carries no alpha. 92 is already visually lossless.
settings.seqFolderNote: Each source gets its own folder: {{file}}
settings.namingPatternNote: The pattern names every output: tokens are resolved at launch. A media renamed in the tray keeps its own name.

token.name: Source file name, without its extension

settings.namingCollision: {{count}} name produced by several sources — the second output would overwrite the first.
settings.outputRtxNote: RTX VSR only writes video: pick another engine to write images.

modelHint.rife-v4.6: Latest general-purpose version included by the official repository.

shaderHint.rtx_vsr: Live action and anime — fixed 2×, NVIDIA.

depthModelHint.distill-any-depth-small: Sharper than Depth Anything V2 Small, just as fast.
depthModelHint.distill-any-depth-large: A very detailed map, frame by frame.
depthModelHint.video-depth-anything-small: Video — no flicker from frame to frame. The fastest.
depthModelHint.video-depth-anything-large: Video — no flicker, the most detail.
depthModelHint.video-depth-anything-metric-large: Video, real distances — the most detail.
depthModelHint.da3-base: Frame by frame — between Small and Large.
depthModelHint.da3-large: Frame by frame — the most detailed map.
depthModelHint.da3-metric-large: Real distances, not just a near-to-far gradient.
depthModelHint.da3-mono-large: A variant specialised in single-image depth.
depthModelHint.da3-giant: Frame by frame — the most detail in the catalogue. Heavy.
depthModelHint.dpt-swinv2-tiny: The lightest in the catalogue. Works at 256 px.
depthModelHint.dpt-hybrid-midas: The old classic: it copes with almost anything.
depthModelHint.dpt-swinv2-large: Works at 384 px, more detailed than Base.
depthModelHint.dpt-beit-large: Works at 512 px — the most detailed DPT.
depthModelHint.dpt-large: Single-image depth. Copes with very different scenes.

segModelHint.lucida: Transparency, camouflage, text and glows. Soft alpha, frame by frame.
segModelHint.ben2: 4K images — very fine hair and edges.
segModelHint.rvm: Real-time video matte, steady from frame to frame.

errors.depthUnavailable: Depth unavailable: {{err}}. Check that the core service and the Python venv are running (restart NetsuRush).
